comparisons.author_judgement: Li⁺ 溶剂化越弱 CE 越高，DOL/F4DEE 最高
comparisons.quote: Electrolytes with weaker Li+ solvation generally deliver higher CE. Among them, DOL/ F4DEE delivers the highest CE of 98.25%

comparisons.unit: mAh/g（第 II 段放电容量，长链液–液还原）
comparisons.point: GITT 首次放电第 II 段
comparisons.author_judgement: 弱多硫化物溶剂化使歧化平衡偏向短链，第 II 段容量低
comparisons.reason_quote: electrolytes with weaker LiPS solvation shift LiPS disproportionation equilibrium toward the formation of shorter-chain LiPS species
comparisons.quote: The DOL/DME cell delivers 900 mAh g−1 on stage II, in sharp contrast to 500 and 400 mAh g−1 in the DOL/F4DEE and DOL/TTE cells. Nevertheless, all three cells similarly deliver 650 mAh g−1 on stage III

comparisons.unit: mAh/g（第 II 段放电容量，长链液–液还原）
comparisons.point: GITT 首次放电第 II 段
comparisons.quote: The DOL/DME cell delivers 900 mAh g−1 on stage II, in sharp contrast to 500 and 400 mAh g−1 in the DOL/F4DEE and DOL/TTE cells

comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/DME 强多硫化物溶剂化，液–液转化多，放电容量最高
comparisons.quote: Among the tested electrolytes, DOL/DME delivers the highest discharge capacity (Figure S29), reflecting enhanced liquid−liquid LiPS conversion due to strong LiPS solvation

comparisons.point: 寿命（DOL/DME 第 55 圈后快速衰减）
comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/DME 长链多硫化物腐蚀 + SEI 差 + LiNO3 消耗；DOL/F4DEE 兼顾正负极
comparisons.reason_quote: Strong Li+ solvation and strong LiPS solvation in DOL/DME trigger poor sulfur reversibility and severe Li anode degradation, resulting in quick capacity fading after only 55 cycles
comparisons.note: 作者明写'trade-off between cycle life and specific capacity'；200 µm 锂对 3.5 mg/cm² 硫，N/P 约 10
comparisons.quote: Strong Li+ solvation and strong LiPS solvation in DOL/DME trigger poor sulfur reversibility and severe Li anode degradation, resulting in quick capacity fading after only 55 cycles … These attributes contribute to a highly prolonged Li−S cycle life of over 180 cycles

comparisons.author_judgement: 弱化的 Li⁺ 与多硫化物溶剂化有利于负极
comparisons.quote: the smaller SEI resistance (RSEI) in DOL/F4DEE and DOL/TTE than DOL/DME indicates the benefit of weakened Li+ and LiPS solvation on Li anode

comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/DME Rbulk 剧增，可能来自电解液干涸
comparisons.reason_quote: The drastic increase of Rbulk in DOL/DME (which may come from electrolyte dry-out9) further proves its poor Li cyclability
comparisons.quote: The drastic increase of Rbulk in DOL/DME (which may come from electrolyte dry-out9) further proves its poor Li cyclability

comparisons.unit: %（锂化学腐蚀损失比例，越低越好）
comparisons.author_judgement: 弱多硫化物溶剂化抑制锂腐蚀，但作者说改善幅度较小
comparisons.reason_quote: This proves that weak LiPS solvation can suppress chemical corrosion on Li anode despite its relatively small benefit
comparisons.quote: Per Figure S18b, LiPS solutions with weaker LiPS solvation result in lower Li inventory loss ratio. This proves that weak LiPS solvation can suppress chemical corrosion on Li anode despite its relatively small benefit
